Channel.description: push is browser push to a visitor, staff_push browser push to a member of your staff.

MessageStatus.description: queued: waiting for its time (a delayed send or quiet hours) or being sent; retrying: an attempt failed and it is tried again on a later use of your website; sent; failed: every attempt failed, the fallback channel's too; skipped: not sent (reason unsubscribed, limited or switched_off).

ReasonValues.description: The values of a reason code, for example { "status": "503" } for provider_status or { "template": "chat.staff_new_message" } for not_set_up. The delivery-log widget words each code with your widget text reason.<code>, filled with these values.

provider.description: smtp, resend, sendgrid, mailgun, ses, twilio, meta, http (a gateway over HTTP) or webpush; none when no provider was called (the feature is off, the channel is not connected, a database or provider was briefly unreachable).

reason.description: Why it failed, as a code (failed attempts only): provider_status ({status}), provider_refused, provider_unreachable ({cause}), provider_error ({cause}), connection_unusable ({connection}), feature_off ({feature}), not_connected ({connection}), no_subscription, subscription_gone, interrupted, sealed_unreadable or not_set_up ({template}, {fallbackTemplate}). Never a sentence.

detail.description: The provider's own answer, as it came (technical, at most 200 characters, secrets removed); failed attempts at a provider only.

Message.description: A message as the delivery log keeps it. It never holds a secret: the values of a sensitive template (every accounts. template) and those the send named in secretValues show as ****** (or [link hidden] for a link) in subject and text; the recipient got the real words.

template.description: The template key; null for a one-off message from your staff.

source.description: api: your server or a product; staff: your staff in the admin widgets.

channel.description: The channel now: after a fallback, the fallback channel.

to.description: The address on channel: an email address (lower case), a phone number (+ and digits), a browser push subscriber id or a staff user id.

reason.description: A code, never a sentence. skipped: unsubscribed (from every optional message, or from its topic), limited (over a send limit) or switched_off (the product's message is switched off on this channel); retrying and failed: why the last attempt failed (see Attempt.reason; a product's message on WhatsApp without your WhatsApp template fails as not_set_up); else null.

topic.description: The unsubscribe topic it belongs to (its template's settings, or a marketing one-off message's topic); null: none. A recipient unsubscribed from the topic does not get it unless it is required.

subject.description: The email subject or push title ('' for SMS and WhatsApp), hidden values replaced.

attempts.description: Every attempt, on every channel, oldest first.

dueAt.description: When it is (or was) due: later for a delayed send, quiet hours or a retry.

MessagePage.description: One page of the delivery log, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

Values.description: The template's {placeholders}: up to 50 names (a letter, then letters, digits and _; not unsubscribeUrl, which Notifications fills) with texts of at most 1000 characters (50000 for a value named in longValues) or numbers, 100000 characters in all.

subject.description: Email subject or push title (required there; not on SMS).

text.description: The default text, with {placeholders} and {?name}…{/name} sections like any template.

translations.description: The words in other languages, by language code (fr, pt-BR): { subject?, text }. The recipient's language (language, else to.language) picks them, exact then its base language; else the words above (US English) are sent.

Defaults.description: The default words of the message per channel: every product adds the ones it declares to each send of its messages. They are used while your website has no template of its own for the channel (its language version, else its default version), and kept for the fallback channel. Checked as a template you save. WhatsApp never has a default: it sends only templates approved at Meta.

EmailRecipient.description: The recipient: email is required; phone is used by the fallback channel (SMS or WhatsApp). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

email.description: An email address (kept in lower case).

phone.description: With its calling code: + or 00 first, for example +447700900123; spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and brackets are dropped, and a trunk 0 after the code too.

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

PhoneRecipient.description: The recipient: phone is required; email is used by the fallback channel (email). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

phone.description: With its calling code: + or 00 first, for example +447700900123; spaces, dashes, dots, slashes and brackets are dropped, and a trunk 0 after the code too.

email.description: An email address (kept in lower case).

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

SubscriberRecipient.description: The recipient: a visitor's browser. Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

subscriberId.description: The subscriber id the push-permission widget announces (the ss-notifications:subscribed event).

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

StaffRecipient.description: The recipient: a member of your staff, on every browser where they turned staff notifications on (at most 20). Each member given must be valid (422 validation_failed at to/<member>).

staffId.description: The user id in their ticket.

language.description: The recipient's language, for example en, fr or pt-BR: it picks the template version while Multi-language templates are on.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Paris: quiet hours end in it (else the business.json time zone).

Button.description: A button of a WhatsApp template at Meta that takes a value.

index.description: The button's place in the template at Meta (the first is 0), once each.

type.description: url: the value is added to the end of the button's address; copy_code: the button copies the value.

value.description: May hold placeholders and optional sections, for example {code}.

Template.description: A template: one per key, channel and language.

key.description: Keys of other products' own messages start with the product id and a dot (for example accounts. or ecommerce.); every other key is yours.

language.description: default for the version every recipient falls back to, else a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR.

subject.description: The email subject or push title ('' for SMS and WhatsApp).

text.description: The words: {name} where a value goes, {?name}…{/name} around text shown only when name is not empty.

required.description: Sent also to people who unsubscribed (always true for accounts. templates).

urgent.description: Sent during quiet hours (always true for accounts. templates).

providerTemplate.description: WhatsApp: the name of an approved template at Meta ('' sends plain text).

buttons.description: By index; only a WhatsApp template with a providerTemplate has them.

sensitive.description: Its values are hidden in the delivery log (always true for accounts. templates).

TemplateInput.description: A template to save: one with the same key, channel and language is replaced.

key.description: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits, _, . or -, starting with a letter.

language.description: default ('', null or none) for the default version, else a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR.

subject.description: Required for email, push and staff_push: one line of at most 200 characters (trimmed); ignored for SMS and WhatsApp.

text.description: Trimmed, not empty; at most 100,000 characters for email, 1600 for SMS, 4096 for WhatsApp and 500 for push. Every {?name} is closed by a later {/name}.

providerTemplate.description: WhatsApp only: the template name at Meta (lower case, digits and _, at most 512).

buttons.description: Only for a WhatsApp template with a providerTemplate.

TemplateList.description: The templates, by key, channel and language.

PushSubscriptionInput.description: The browser's subscription as PushSubscription.toJSON() gives it.

p256dh.description: The browser's P-256 public key (65 bytes, base64url).

subscriberId.description: The same endpoint keeps its id.

POST /v1/messages/email.summary: Send an email from a template
POST /v1/messages/email.description: The answer is the message as the delivery log keeps it. It is saved before its first attempt and sent at once unless a delayed send or quiet hours hold it; an attempt that fails or breaks off answers retrying and is tried again on later uses of your website, then on the fallback channel. Someone who unsubscribed gets only required messages (else skipped, reason unsubscribed); send limits skip with reason limited. A product's message (accounts., chat. …) carries its defaults, used while your website has no template of its own for the channel; one you switched off on the channel is skipped (reason switched_off). 422 template_not_found when the key has no email template and no default; 422 validation_failed for a field; 403 feature_off for your own keys without Merchant send API (send_api), or sendAt without Delayed send. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request sends once.

secretValues.description: Names of values the delivery log hides, for example ["code", "link"].

linkValues.description: Names of values that hold a link, for example ["link"]. A link goes into the message only as an https address on one of your website's own hosts (its domain, a host listed for it in the Portal, or the sending product's host), with no port, credentials or spaces; anything else refuses the send with 422 validation_failed, code link_not_allowed at /values/<name>. An empty value is no link.

longValues.description: A product's message: the values that hold long text (up to 50,000 characters each, for example a chat transcript), as the product declares them. They go only in the message: email sends them whole; SMS, WhatsApp and push get them cut to fit, ending with your text message.shortened. Not for your own template keys.

required.description: true sends it also to someone who unsubscribed (for example an order update from an optional template).

language.description: A language code such as en, fr or pt-BR (default: to.language).

sendAt.description: Delayed send: at most 30 days ahead; a past time sends now. accounts. templates always go at once.

fallbackTemplate.description: Another template key: while your website has no template of its own for template, its template for this key is used, before the defaults (for example a per-status order message falls back to the general one). Switching either key off on the channel skips the message.

POST /v1/events.summary: Forward another product's event to your webhook URLs
POST /v1/events.description: Products call it with the Notifications server token right after an event, with the event id as the Idempotency-Key. The event goes, signed, to each webhook URL that takes its type (or every event), and is tried there up to 5 times in all, on later uses of your website. The webhook keeps id and at as its id and createdAt (else a new id and the time it was received). 422 validation_failed for a field.

id.description: The event id in your product.

type.description: <product id>.<event> of any product but Notifications, for example payments.payment.paid.

at.description: When it happened (ISO 8601 with its offset).

data.description: The event's data: at most 16 kB of JSON.

queued.description: Deliveries queued, one per URL that takes the type (0 without the signing secret or such URLs).

status.description: Only messages with this status (another value filters nothing).

channel.description: Only messages on this channel (another value filters nothing).

to.description: Only messages to this address: an email address or a phone number (matched normalized), else a subscriber or staff id.

GET /v1/templates.description: At most 1000, by key, channel and language.

PUT /v1/templates.description: The same checks as the dashboard: 422 validation_failed for a field, or when the website already has 1000 templates; 403 feature_off while the channel's feature is off. Writes count in the settings API's 60 writes per minute (429 rate_limited). The change shows in Recent changes and the activity log (template.saved, template.deleted) with the acting user (SS-Actor-* headers), else Server.

POST /v1/push/subscriptions.summary: Turn on browser push for a visitor
POST /v1/push/subscriptions.description: The push-permission widget calls it with the browser token; send to the answer's id with to: { subscriberId }. 422 validation_failed when the subscription is not an https endpoint with a 65-byte p256dh key and a 16-byte auth secret.

POST /v1/push/subscriptions/remove.summary: Turn off browser push for a visitor
POST /v1/push/subscriptions/remove.description: Removes the subscription when the subscriber id and its endpoint match (the browser proves it holds it); 204 also when there is none.

POST /v1/admin/messages.summary: Send a message from your staff (send message and template editor widgets)
POST /v1/admin/messages.description: Without template: a one-off message with the words typed now, transactional by default (required and urgent: it ignores unsubscribes, quiet hours and send limits that count optional messages only) or marketing (optional: unsubscribes, its topic, quiet hours and send limits apply). It may go by email, SMS, WhatsApp, browser push (to a subscriber id) or staff push (to a staff user id). With template: the saved template with sample values (the template editor's test send). Either is logged as a staff message and in the activity log. The answer is the message as the delivery log keeps it. 422 validation_failed for a field; 422 template_not_found. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request sends once.

to.description: An email address for email; a phone number with its calling code for sms and whatsapp; the browser's subscriber id for push; the staff user id for staff_push.

subject.description: A one-off email or push: required, one line of at most 200 characters (trimmed).

text.description: A one-off message: required, at most 4096 characters (500 on push and staff push; trimmed).

kind.description: A one-off message: transactional (the default; required and urgent) or marketing (optional).

topic.description: A marketing message: one of your unsubscribe topics (the list topics).

template.description: A test send of this saved template (subject and text are then not used).

language.description: With template: the version to use, default or a language code such as en, fr or pt-BR.

GET /v1/admin/templates.description: At most 1000, by key, channel and language.

PUT /v1/admin/templates.description: 422 validation_failed for a field, or when the website already has 1000 templates. The change is in the activity log by the ticket's member of staff.

DELETE /v1/admin/templates/:key/:channel.description: language is default for the default version. 404 not_found when there is no such template.

POST /v1/admin/push/subscriptions.summary: Turn on staff push in this browser (staff notifications widget)
POST /v1/admin/push/subscriptions.description: Saves the browser's subscription for the ticket's user; send to them with to: { staffId: <the user id in the ticket> }. 422 validation_failed when the subscription is not an https endpoint with a 65-byte p256dh key and a 16-byte auth secret.
